method: Rolling backward-supremum right-tailed Dickey-Fuller statistic, a price-only adaptation of Phillips-Shi-Yu
input: positive nominal price/index levels; published series cadence retained, no interpolation; AI proxy is monthly rebalanced equal-weight total returns of French Chips, Hardw, Softw
null: Additive random walk with drift estimated as mean price change; wild bootstrap centered price changes with independent Rademacher signs
warning_rule: At least three consecutive completed months with percentile >=95; signal begins on third month, never backdated
event_hit: At least one active warning in 12 months ending at the last completed month strictly before the historical peak month
controls: Predeclared 12-month contrast windows; absence of named event is not proof of fundamental fair value. Compare the same any-active-warning criterion as event windows
sensitivity: 120 points/minimum20 with all other rules unchanged where enough data exists; not used to choose primary result
statistical_caution: Pointwise bootstrap reference rank is not a probability of a bubble or crash and does not control familywise repeated-monitoring false alarms. Wild bootstrap is a transparent research implementation, not an exact replication of published composite-bootstrap procedures. Price levels omit dividends/fundamentals; test ordinary geometric growth controls.
selection_caution: Famous episodes and available data were chosen retrospectively, with dependent episodes. This is diagnostic replication/stress testing, not an untouched out-of-sample trial or calibrated bubble-probability model. Report every case, failure and excluded series.
